substantiveDecisions.reason: E133 and E102 are anionic at pH 7; minus-side loading and movement toward positive anode are consistent. Different size, shape, charge and matrix can affect mobility. Neither unique identity nor molar mass, purity or guaranteed resolution follows from colour/migration.

Total phosphate is 10 mmol/L and the stated base/acid ratio gives an ideal Henderson–Hasselbalch pH of about 7.00015 using pKa 7.21. Actual pH verification remains essential. 0.160 g/20 mL is 0.8% m/v; 25 mg/50 mL is 0.050% m/v; 5/50 mL is 10% glycerol. Equal-volume mixing halves each dye to 0.025% and retains 10% glycerol.

The named enclosed GT cell, original interlock/leads and compatible ground-isolated supply match the equipment family. Disconnecting before access, qualified casting, recorded actual V/I and temperature stop are explicit. Specified maximum power is 0.6 W and 30-minute energy 1080 J; these are ceilings, not measured heating or local safety approval.
